styleLocks.art: Painterly fantasy concept art, warm late-summer light over a river-trade city, muted earth tones with bright silk accents and an uncanny emerald-green undertone, soft atmospheric haze, cinematic composition, highly detailed environment, 16:9 aspect ratio.
styleLocks.token: Painterly fantasy token portrait for a virtual tabletop, warm late-summer light, muted earth tones with bright silk accents and an uncanny emerald-green undertone. Head and shoulders (or the creature's head and upper body) centred and facing the viewer, the whole subject inside a central circle with a little margin, plain dark hazy background, square 1:1 image, no border, no ring, no text, no watermark.

clocks.name: Druder & the Opalcrests
clocks.goal: Deliver Leath to the buyer (starts tonight)

druder.name: Druder Craggy
druder.notes: Here to perform, not fight. One hand (right sleeve pinned). Crushes the Greater Moth-Step Cocoon at his curtain line: everyone gets one action, then he and Leath are gone, whatever happens. A second cocoon up his sleeve is the backstop.
druder.token: Druder Craggy, a disgraced middle-aged human bard: a thin face ruined around the eyes by drink but lit with fierce theatrical joy, greying hair worn long, a threadbare plum-coloured coat with the right sleeve pinned up below the elbow, a battered lute against his shoulder, a pale white moth crawling out of his left cuff. Charming, wounded and dangerous.

knuckle.name: Knuckle Garro
knuckle.notes: The big, slow stagehand by the door. Flees once Druder is gone.
knuckle.token: Knuckle Garro, a big slow-witted hired thug dressed as a silk tender: broad shoulders, shaved head, a broken nose, clean hands that have never tended silk, a cudgel resting on one shoulder. Heavy and patient.

spool.name: Spool Dace
spool.notes: The wiry stagehand by the crane. Surrenders when grappled and talks within minutes: the Opalcrests are paying; the buyer is at Wrenmouth, below the upper falls.
spool.token: Spool Dace, a wiry, twitchy young bandit posing as a silk tender: narrow face, darting eyes, a knit cap, threads of white silk caught on his sleeves, a short blade held low. Nervous and quick.

mirela.name: Mirela
mirela.notes: Masked, poling the skiff in the reeds below the cliff. Takes Druder and Leath upriver.
mirela.token: Mirela, a lean masked river scout: a dark cloth mask over the lower face, sharp grey eyes, river-stained leathers, a long punting pole and a shortbow across her back, reeds behind her. Silent and watchful.
